spanish: Y llamaron al pueblo a sacrificios de sus dioses, y comió el pueblo, y se postraron a sus dioses.

findings.issue: «al pueblo» adds a definite article; the token is only preposition + masculine singular absolute, with no article (the articulated «el pueblo» is the later token).
«llamaron» and both «sus» leave unmarked the 3fp subject and the 3fp possessive suffixes, so the second «sus» can be read as the masculine bowers rather than the feminine possessors.

notes: Number, person, qal vs hishtaphel, construct plural, both god-phrases, and the singular-then-plural verb shift match the packet.
